name: tender-supplier-evaluation-ai
description: Single-user web app to evaluate supplier proposals against a tender contract using TED data and Gemini AI.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
